searchText: Cool, that matches my expectations. Meetings will continue to **not** be recorded. I'll still encourage coordinated note taking of some kind to generally provide visibility into what people are working on without going into a level of detail that gets in the way of people feeling like they can discuss things openly. What clients besides fluffy and trin are trying to implement a light client for portal network? i saw there were 2 other participants in cdap working on implementations for those, and i was planning on working on a diff implementation, otherwise, i'll just hop on one of those Right now, trin and fluffy and *maybe* EthereumJS team are the implementations that I'm aware of. CDAP participants are planning to pile onto one of trin/fluffy to the best of my knowledge.
